Raghu —

Appreciate the time yesterday. AtlasIQ's pilot looks like the fastest path we've seen to meaningful token ops on the platform, and I want to make sure we keep momentum into the close window. If it helps accelerate procurement and the exec sign-off, we can do a limited EOQ "lightning bonus": a 3-week extension of your current trial plus a one-off 250k token usage credit usable within the paid onboarding term.

- Trial extended from 30 -> 51 days (3 extra weeks)
- 250,000 token usage credit applied to the first 60 days after conversion (non-transferable)
- Standard security/compliance SOW and IP protections apply

If this is attractive, I can loop in my manager and sales ops now for formal approval and a short MSA addendum. Happy to attach a quick mutual action plan and the brief terms.

Thoughts?
